content.question: What does the output gate in an LSTM do?
options: Decides which new candidate information is written into the cell state.
Regulates what information from the cell state is exposed to the next time step as the next hidden state.
Combines retained past information with the new candidate.
Resets the cell state to zero at every time step.
content.answer: Regulates what information from the cell state is exposed to the next time step as the next hidden state.
